entries.title: Does the representation ranking survive a change of assay?
entries.summary: Frozen primary and replication MAE are separate populations. Morgan's adverse replication result remains visible.

entries.title: 表示方法的排名能否跨测定保持？
entries.summary: 冻结的主测定与复现测定 MAE 属于不同总体；保留 Morgan 的不利复现结果。

entries.title: How much of the original top decile is recovered at each equal-budget checkpoint?
entries.summary: Retrospective recovery is copied from every retained fixed policy. Random seeds are policy instances, not independent biological replicates.

entries.title: 在每个相同预算检查点，原始最高十分位回收了多少？
entries.summary: 回顾性回收率直接复制自全部保留的固定策略；随机种子是策略实例，不是独立生物学重复。

entries.title: What can a within-system energy comparison establish?
entries.summary: Retained energy errors use separately fitted models. Per-frame Ridge predictions were not retained, so no residual scatter is supplied.

entries.title: 系统内能量比较能够支持什么结论？
entries.summary: 保留的能量误差来自分别拟合的模型；原始逐帧 Ridge 预测未保留，因此不提供残差散点图。
